metaTitle: Water Filter vs Water Purifier for Camping
description: Filters remove protozoa and bacteria but usually not viruses; purifiers also handle viruses. Learn which you need for camping and backpacking water.
directAnswer: A filter strains out protozoa and most bacteria but usually not viruses, while a purifier also deals with viruses through chemicals, UV, boiling or a virus stage. Most US backcountry water needs only a filter.
